chunks: They ask you about the Hour: when is its determined time? Say: 'Only my Lord has the knowledge. No one can reveal it except He. Oppressive will it be for the heavens and the earth. When it comes, it will come unawares.' They ask you about it as if you were in the know. You tell them: 'Only God has the knowledge.' But most people do not know.

key_terms.السَّاعَة: The Hour, referring to the Day of Resurrection or the end of time
key_terms.عِلْمُهَا: Its knowledge, referring to the precise timing
key_terms.مُرْسَاهَا: Its determined time or fixed moment

ai.seo_question: When is the Hour (Day of Judgment) according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (Ayat al-Sa'ah) is often cited to distinguish between the Prophet's role as a warner and the exclusive domain of God's knowledge regarding the exact moment of the Hour, reinforcing the concept of divine hiddenness (Ghaybah) of time. The phrase 'thiqalata' (it weighs heavy) is interpreted by scholars like Al-Tabarsi and Al-Kulayni as indicating the magnitude and suddenness of the event for those unprepared, serving as a spiritual wake-up call. This underscores the practical implication for believers to maintain constant readiness (Yaqazah) rather than fixating on speculative chronologies.
